title: Quick Crisp German Pork Stir Fry
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring crispy pork, juniper berries, and a stir-fry made in a kazan cauldron, suitable for shojin-friendly diets. This recipe is easy to make and serves a family of four.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a kazan cauldron over medium-high heat.
Add the pork belly and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the cauldron and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the cauldron and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the cauldron and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the crushed juniper berries, salt, and black pepper to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Return the pork to the cauldron and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the pork is crispy and the vegetables are tender.
